description: Non-material amendment to planning permission reference: 2025/01884/FUL dated 11th September 2025 for the "Demolition of existing single storey lean-to rear extension and single storey side extension; erection of a rear extension at second floor level, over part of the existing two storey back addition; erection of a single storey rear extension, to the side of ground floor back addition; installation of a rooflight in the front roofslope; repositioning, re-sizing and replacement of an existing window to the side elevation, and re-sizing and replacement of an existing window to the rear elevation of first floor back addition; installation of French doors to the rear elevation of ground floor back addition; formation of a courtyard between the rear of the main building and proposed single storey rear extension, including installation of a window to the side elevation, and installation of French doors to the rear elevation of the main building." Amendments sought to include; repositioning, re-sizing and replacement of an existing rooflight in the front roofslope; replacement of an existing window to the rear elevation at second floor level; repositioning, re-sizing and replacement of an approved window to the rear elevation of second floor back addition; replacement of an existing window to the rear elevation, repositioning, re-sizing and replacement of a window to the side elevation and a window to the rear elevation of first floor back addition; enlargement of proposed single storey side extension and replacement of the flat roof with glazed pitched roof following the omission of the internal courtyard, and re-sizing and replacement of French doors to the rear elevation at ground floor level.
